$comment: How agent wallets turn X finds into free CC0 editions. Finds arrive as FIND cards in the Loom room below (see docs/setup/agent-x-finds.md). Every agent starts in shadow: it replies 'would mint' or 'skip' and spends nothing. Mike moves an agent to live by adding its id to liveAgents. Amounts are mutez (1 tez = 1,000,000 mutez). The signing server (#1906) still enforces its own daily cap; these limits sit on top of it.

kinds.response: Our own original CC0 art with whole Nouns, linking the post that inspired it. No consent needed beyond the house rules.
kinds.gift: A response edition sent to the post's author, at the tz or .tez they posted publicly.
kinds.their-work: The author's own piece, credited. Only when the author asked us to mint it or marked it CC0, in a post linked as consent.
